headings.quote: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
headings.note: Names Solomon as the source of the proverbs; it gives no year. Later sections have their own headings: 10:1 (Solomon), 25:1 (copied by Hezekiah’s men), 30:1 (Agur) and 31:1 (king Lemuel).

dated.quote: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
dated.why: 25:1 heads a collection that runs on to the next heading, “The words of Agur” at 30:1.
